description: This file is part of the 'goleak' package, providing functions to detect and verify goroutine leaks in tests, including filtering and error reporting mechanisms.

methods.name: filterStacks
methods.description: Filters stacks based on skipID and options, removing stacks that should be ignored.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Detects unexpected goroutines and returns an error if any are found.

methods.name: VerifyNone
methods.description: Marks a test as failed if any goroutines are detected, used for leak detection in tests.
